description: CALIBRATE aims to develop a globally applicable calibration standard for quantitative in-situ electron microscopy.
funding_summary: The project has received a 'Proof of Concept' grant from the ERC, amounting to €150,000 over 18 months.
inflection_why_now: The increasing complexity of in-situ electron microscopy experiments necessitates precise calibration standards, making CALIBRATE's development timely.
devils_advocate_risks: Potential challenges in translating theoretical calibration methods into practical, widely adoptable standards.
Dependence on continued ERC funding and institutional support for project completion.
